entries.content: PR #75 triage confirmed local unit tests pass, deep regression was blocked by npm cache ownership, and harness:check requires current closeout metadata.

For diagram-cli npm releases, use the GitHub Release workflow on main with auth_mode=trusted. Local npm publish can require an npm OTP even when ~/.npmrc has a valid token; trusted publishing run 25435539149 shipped @brainwav/diagram@1.1.0 and created tag v1.1.0.
